title: THE RENDER WEEK · The town loads
venue: Arthur's site · a science-fiction week the papers declined · posted once, taken down
logline: A science-fiction week the papers declined: the town as a render in progress. Monday: the seawall drawn in wireframe, then the flats, then the shack, each panel a little more solid, a progress bar under each, and Wood and the dog on the bench fully drawn from the first panel, waiting for the town to finish. It doesn't, by Friday.

panels.composition: The seawall in phosphor-green wireframe, the bay a grid; WOOD and BARNABY on the bench fully drawn.
